symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Collects this frame's HitNotificationRequestOneFrame entities and any entities still carrying UnresolvedHitNotificationComponent into a per-target table of pending notifications (0x40 bytes each). For each target it consults whether the target is dead (DeathComponent) or dying later (DelayedDeathComponent). On one side of a condition that was not resolved (see unknown) it creates a NEW entity per notification carrying esv::hit::HitNotificationEventOneFrameComponent (0x50 bytes) with a boolean set differently in the three creating loops (0 in one, 1 in the other two); on the other side it adds esv::hit::UnresolvedHitNotificationComponent (0x10 bytes, a list of pending notifications) to the target entity. UnresolvedHitNotificationComponent is also removed (RemoveComponentUnchecked) on a path whose condition was not resolved; 'once the pending list is settled' is an inference from its place. Finally one query's entities (the request one-frame entities, by the pattern) are destroyed.
